notes.title: Several Bug Fixes and Improvements
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/1443ffa6a6c0b0cfaf044fa413e378b0c32072e3.png[/img]
We've uploaded update v. 1.16.3.14 with various bug fixes across stages, heroes, towers, enemies, navigation, and UI to improve overall gameplay stability and experience.

[b]Read the full changelog:[/b]

[h1]Bug fixes[/h1]


[h2]Level and Stage Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixes taunt positions in stages 32, 37, 41
[*] fixes tower ember lords terrain hover
[*] prevents fog pseudo-towers from being hovered/focused
[*] fixes stage 41 secondary paths 2,3,4 missing
[*] fixes stage 41 gold steal parrot position
[*] fixes stage 16 and 19 taunt balloon position
[*] fixes stage 11 freeze hover image missing
[*] fixes stage 11 left cave mask width
[*] shows loading background 1 when opening tutorial
[*] fixes texture detail in stage 37
[*] fixes disappearing holder banners
[*] fixes desktop stage art glitches stages 6 and 10
[*] fixes stage 41 masks offset and zorder with holders[/list]

[h2]Hero and Tower Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixes Snow Golem removal recovering nearest tower in stages 20-22
[*] fixes Arcane Magus using teleport when possessed by Lucerna
[*] Lucerna is no longer affected by Master Architects
[*] Sandworm and Ignis Altar are now affected by Master Architects
[*] fixes Beresad ult display
[*] fixes oloch ultimate moving when casted in path 3
[*] fixes Blazing Gem's Unstable Power upgrade scaling
[*] fixes Oloch buffing Sarcophagus
[*] fixes Ignis Altar not being affected by damage multipliers
[*] fixes Goblirangs Angry Bee not attacking flying enemies
[*] fixes Burning Fuel's damage
[*] fixes Wicked Sisters targeting Carnival Dragons with Froggification
[*] fixes HeroTank crash when spawning soldiers near path start
[*] fixes tower worm damage in encyclopedia
[*] fixes Winter Queen tower block not focusable
[*] some desert eagle fixes[/list]

[h2]Enemies[/h2][list]
[*] fixes Stonebeard Geomancer and Bullshark Dasher size modifier
[*] fixes Risen Cutthroats summoned by the fog from dead allied units giving gold
[*] fixes units summoning on unopened level 41 paths[/list]

[h2]Navigation and Focus[/h2]
[list]
[*] customizes tower nav overrides
[*] fixes crash in FocusNav
[*] fixes dismissing map rooms help with controller
[*] fixes tower room equipped towers navigation
[*] prevents equipping a locked tower in tower room
[*] fixes focus when popping hero/tower room help
[*] fixes hero/tower room help tooltip positions
[*] refactors wave flag tooltips positioning using anchor points
[*] fixes navigation overrides in upgrades room
[*] changes widget navigation distance calculation to use dyn nav algorithm
[*] nav override in hero room done/reset buttons
[*] disables mouse listener that reverts pointer
[*] focus nav override for briefing difficulty button
[*] fixes navigation in options down from slider
[*] fixes undoing tower selection after a build/upgrade of another ends
[*] re-enables navigation after end cutscenes
[*] fixes unreachable top item in quickmenu for level 4 towers
[*] fixes tower rally snapping outside range
[*] fixes quickmenu not showing tooltip on second opening[/list]

[h2]Encyclopedia and UI[/h2]
[list]
[*] removes borders from comic 15 images (pirates dlc)
[*] fixes enemies health in encyclopedia with current difficulty
[*] fixes instakill missing in encyclopedia for Polyx and Hanged Captain
[*] fixes missing shadows in encyclopedia, green dots in some towers
[*] now shows instakill in infobar instead of None
[*] adds missing instakill damage to deep king info[/list]

[h2]Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixes tower sell sounds not working when using keys/controller
[*] increases worm_nest_buy_skill sound
[*] adds limit_instances to bucaneer range attack sounds[/list]

[h2]General and Stability[/h2]
[list]
[*] fixes several issues in data files
[*] fixes windows plist malformed in notifications/tips
[*] fixes page background glitches
[*] adds proxies for scramInfobar and others in KRGameplayScene
[*] fix stun id modifiers
[*] recovers from broken save game with empty tips key in notifications[/list]

[h2]Controller and Input Handling[/h2]
[list]
[*] controller: fixes “Press any button” not reacting to most buttons
[*] controller: restores pointer behaviour when selecting hero with keys
[*] controller: changes how pointer behaves when selecting hero with shoulder buttons[/list]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] implements dynamic navigation mode for stages where towers are removed during the fight and overrides cannot be used (stages 20-22)
[*] improves encyclopedia navigation, changes page change sound
[*] improve navigation by making dyn nav distance wider
[*] improves navigation in tower and hero rooms
[*] avoids jumping to the other side when there is nothing to focus towards the selected direction
[*] improves mouse pointer tracking speed with joystick
[*] heavy refactor of pointer handling when switching between mouse/joystick/keyboard
[*] enables map flags panning with focus change
[*] hammerage melee attack can no longer be silenced
[*] Spectro now bleeds in violet instead of red
[/list]

notes.title: Balance Changes and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/a998ffb5848c1c079c7e2a047259db8d4e1383f7.jpg[/img]

Hey, Rushers! While working on the Hammerhold Campaign, we thought, "Why not make things even more awesome?" So, we've smoothed out some pesky bugs and tweaked the balance, all thanks to your suggestions. You don't need to purchase the DLC to see the upgrades.

Curious? Check out the changes below.

[h2]BALANCE CHANGES
[/h2]
[list]
[*] Crow damage 1/2 -> 2/4
[*] Demon Guard melee 4-8 -> 6-10
[*] Demon Guard lifetime 12s -> 18s
[*] Demon Guard death explosion damage 10/40 -> 20/50
[*] Orc Shaman damage 4-20/10-55/20-110/35-190 -> 4-20/12-55/25-110/40-190
[*] Static Shock damage 3-13/6-26/10-38 -> 5-20/10-35/15-50
[*] Rocket Riders damage 7-10/20-29/40-58/64-92 -> 8-12/23-33/46-68/74-104
[*] Minefield cost 300/300/300 -> 225/225/225
[*] Biggarang damage 27-49/32-60/43-81 -> 30-55/35-65/45-90
[*] Abrasive Heat range 400 -> 530
[*] Blazing Gem level 1 damage 2-4/4-8/6-12 -> 2-4/4-7/6-10
[*] Blazing Gem level 2 damage 6-9/12-18/18-27 -> 6-9/11-17/16-25
[*] Blazing Gem level 3 damage 10-16/20-32/30-48 -> 10-15/20-30/30-45
[*] Blazing Gem level 4 damage 16-24/32-48/48-72/64-96 -> 14-22/30-44/44-65/58-88
[*] Grim Cemetery level 4 default spawner cooldown 15s -> 12s (matches other levels)
[*] Bloated Corpses cooldown 12s -> 3s
[*] More monks cost 350/350/350 -> 175/175/175
[*] Ignis Altar damage type physical -> explosive
[*] Ignis Altar puddles now stack
[/list]
Find the full Changelog complete with bug fixes  [url=https://github.com/cigumo/krvi/wiki/Changelog#v11540--18-12-2023-steam---testing]here[/url].

notes.title: The Primal Ravage update is here
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/7d2120a0fb52093c577888d23b61102b4ed82e3b.png[/img]

General!

The day has arrived and our new update,  Primal Ravage, is now available!
Go now and take command of my troops and show them those unworthy dwarves and dinosaurs who the rightful ruler of this land is!

I am pretty sure they will get petrified once they see you charge, and those dwarves will not be a BIG problem, for sure!

In this new adventure you will have to face 3 new stages with a thrilling boss fight. You can count on the aid of a new tower and a new hero I’m leaving at your disposal!

Get ready as there are new enemies on the rise but you can also unlock 4 new achievements!

I am done with the talking, go now and fulfill my revenge!

notes.title: New Kingdom Rush Vengance update: Primal Ravage coming September 29!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38525140/068ae643eec44a6c74dd735778ae40bc3ad2d48f.jpg[/img]

My loyal Generals!! 

[b]A NEW UPDATE is coming to Vengeance on September 29,[/b] and you need to prepare for it!
Some pesky and ancient-looking little dwarves are emerging from the ancient mines. 

Normally that would not be a problem for our troops, but they are bringing with them some disgusting lizard-like creatures that have very pointy claws and teeth, and they are keen on using them!

Since I am busy with other issues I am sending a new hero, Grosh, and a new tower, the Ignus Altar, on my behalf. You better not disappoint me or you will feel my rage!

While you are at it, punish those pesky dwarves that opened the mine passage and allied with their ancient counterparts. Apparently, there is no shortage of dwarves in these lands!

[i][b]Get your sword, shield, and spells ready! I am counting on you... or else…!
[/b][/i]
